tasks.dev: deno task setup:dev && cd tauri && deno task tauri dev
tasks.build: ./scripts/build-server.sh && cd tauri && deno task tauri build
tasks.generate:keys: cd tauri && deno task tauri signer generate -w ~/.tauri/voicebox.key
tasks.typecheck: deno task typecheck:app && deno task typecheck:web
tasks.typecheck:app: cd app && deno exec npm:typescript/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
tasks.ci: deno task typecheck && deno task build:web
